 Qualcomm signs a multiyear SpaceX deal to supply Dragonwing hardware and network software for “tens of thousands of cell sites” for a US-wide network in 2027   —  Qualcomm Inc. will supply hardware components for SpaceX's planned nationwide terrestrial wireless network …
